author: Xvius
body:
I am banned because of my username.
They said that my username was inappropriate.
How is it inappropriate? This account name is actually a special word which I use to talk with my friends.... 
This is quite unfair!

replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
Your username is "shitload" in another language. Under no circumstances is that acceptable. Your appeal is denied and you will have to wait until it expires. Failure to change your name to a reasonable IGN, will result in a permanent ban. Keep in mind, you may evade this ban on a different account. Furthermore..

This appeal is denied...

*I'll leave this open for 24 hours if you have anything to say.*
